verdict.rationale: Claude Cowork's scheduled tasks are documented as running automatically on a recurring basis or on demand. Claude handles the task on your schedule and delivers finished outputs such as reports, briefings and summaries, so you can step away and come back to completed work. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of one-off tasks scheduled for a specific future time (only 'on demand' is documented), details on how results are delivered or notified, independent or hands-on corroboration.
